items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Connie Mack used to come over to our auditorium the beginning of each season, and bring three or four of his so called stars, and then invite the whole school over for a game.

ctx.x: And that’s where I got to love baseball. Connie Mack used to come over to our auditorium the beginning of each season, and bring three or four of his so called stars, and then invite the whole school over for a game. So one I remember in particular we played one of the powerhouse Yankees, and they just beat the pants off us. Every one of them hit at least two home runs. But I love baseball. And then coming back up Lehigh Avenue - which was where it was - to Broad Street -which was the main north-south street of…
Could you tell me what that album was? No?
